phases.name: Fork bootstrap + StorageAdapter interface skeleton + MarkdownAdapter scaffold
phases.goal: A locked StorageAdapter TypeScript contract exists, with a MarkdownAdapter scaffold that delegates to today's `node:fs` code, wired into `index.js` via dependency injection — and we know how that contract relates to upstream's recent seam work before we commit.

phases.name: Wire core read methods to adapter
phases.goal: Every SDK read query — including the ~13 workflow init bundlers and every skill frontmatter `@.planning/...` reference — flows through the adapter, not direct `node:fs`.
phases.depends_on: Phase 1 (the interface must exist before reads can route through it)

phases.name: Wire core write methods + recordStateEvent
phases.goal: Every SDK write goes through the adapter; the 10+ ad-hoc state-mutation handlers collapse into one `recordStateEvent({type, payload})` discriminated-union call, and `phase-lifecycle.js`'s 13 handlers route through Bin B named methods over Bin A primitives.
phases.depends_on: Phase 1 (interface) and Phase 2 (read patterns inform write patterns and a routed read surface is needed to verify writes round-trip correctly)

phases.name: Plug workflow leaks (top-10 + `<context>`-block class)
phases.goal: The 10 heaviest leaking workflows + the new `<context>`-block frontmatter leak class no longer touch `.planning/` directly; a CI gate prevents regression; the two raw-git outliers are fixed.
phases.depends_on: Phase 3 (writes must already route through the adapter so leaks can be replaced cleanly)

phases.name: Foundational primitive lift
phases.goal: The six foundational primitives are implemented and adopted, and the dry-run pipeline is hoisted off the filesystem so it works on any adapter — gating BeadsAdapter readiness per the SYNTHESIS §9 high-severity risk.
phases.depends_on: Phase 3 (write surface must be stable before primitive lift refactors it)

phases.name: BeadsAdapter implementation
phases.goal: A complete `BeadsAdapter` implementation against `bd` exists in the sibling repo, built against the *primitive-lifted* StorageAdapter interface (post-Phase 5), with the knowledge-graph-subsystem scope decision resolved.
phases.depends_on: Phase 5 (BeadsAdapter is implemented against the primitive-lifted interface, not the pre-lift one — per SYNTHESIS §9 high-severity risk: "Don't ship Phase 6 until dry-run is stable on MarkdownAdapter")

phases.name: Conformance test suite
phases.goal: A conformance test suite asserts MarkdownAdapter and BeadsAdapter produce equivalent outcomes for every Bin B method, every record-type round-trip, every section-mode semantic, and every dry-run failure-injection scenario.
phases.depends_on: Phase 6 (need both adapter implementations to run conformance against)

phases.name: Migration + distribution
phases.goal: Existing markdown-backed users have a working migration path to bd and a documented distribution story (fork rebase, leak-grep CI behavior on rebase, conflict playbook, PR-vs-long-lived-fork decision).
phases.depends_on: Phase 7 (the migration tool needs a conformance-validated adapter pair so users can trust the round-trip)

recommended_actions.phase_name: Wire core read methods to adapter
